items.Sentence: The actual percolation capacity of the proposed effluent storage ponds will be evaluated and may require the need for additional effluent storage ponds to achieve the 0.325 mgd disposal capacity of Phase 2.
The existing WWTF, percolation/evaporation ponds, and land application areas are in Assessor’s Parcel Number (APN) 053-090-11.
